get.description: Readiness: embedding model loaded (set at startup) and the Qdrant alias reachable.
Authenticated status for the API's admin status card; emits one span to Phoenix.

post.description:
Store the original and queue its ingest (D52); poll `GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}`. The same
bytes again keep their version; parse errors end the job `failed`.
Retrieval as the chat runs it, for the inspector; no threshold unless one is given.

patch.description: Change the labels of all chunks of a document without re-embedding (D48, D61).

delete.description: Cancels a queued ingest; removes the vectors from every collection and the originals.

post.description:
Agent turn, SSE v2: `step`, `tool_call`, `tool_result`, `sources`, `token`…, `done`
(plan-phase-2 §7.3); a write call ends it with `approval_required`, and `resume` continues
it. `mode=rag` runs the Phase 1 pipeline and ends with the same `done`.

get.description: The model registry (D40); the API filters it by the caller's role.
The tool registry (D30); the API filters it by the caller's role.
Where the alias points, and the latest runs with their reports.

post.description: Build a collection from the stored originals, gate it on the golden set, swap (D55).
Point the alias back at the collection the last swap replaced.

ExplainedHit.title: ExplainedHit
ExplainedHit.description:
`explain` mode of `/v1/search`: the matching chunk inside the section, and the section's
rank among the fused candidates and the chunk's in the dense and the sparse top 50 (None: not
among them); its position is the reranked one, moved by `boost` positions (D61).

ModelInfo.title: ModelInfo
ModelInfo.description: One `config/models.yaml` entry (D40); `id` is the model id at LLM_BASE_URL.

Resume.title: Resume
Resume.description: The user's decision on an `approval_required` action (D28).
